race.description: Cm Steel & Rural P/L The Barb Ida Traill Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: WESTERN WARRIOR (3) drops a couple of grades for this and is ready for the 1400m. Covered ground in the run with a plugging fifth over 1200m at Mudgee. Overdue for a win and he has winning prospects. SUNDAY (10) consistent mare who will appreciate the firmer surface. Produced solid closing splits when second over 1400m at Mudgee. No surprise to see her get the victory. YORKEL (6) resumed two weeks ago over 1200m at Mudgee and was only beaten 0.8 lengths into fourth. Second-up record is sound. Ugly set-up today and goes into the exotics. THE CONFIDANTE (9) was narrowly beaten last time over 1300m at Moree, finishing just half a length from the winner in second. Well placed to feature.
